purpose: CRM rail audit: separates CRM as training/guidance/memory surface, accident causal surface, and positive-control resilience surface.

crm_surfaces.note: United 173 shows communication/command-gradient/fuel-state awareness issues as source-backed precursor surface.
FAA AC 120-51E is encoded as guidance, not implementation proof.
United 232 shows CRM as part of resilience under catastrophic failure while preserving design/inspection causes.
FAA Lessons Learned modules make accident lessons teachable but do not prove correction infusion.

audit_guardrails: CRM is not a magic fix.
CRM is not a substitute for design redundancy, inspection, automation clarity, or regulator/operator oversight.
Absence of CRM is not presumed unless source-backed.
